answer: At dawn each epoch, reputation is recalculated from verifiable work history, and any identity that fails to sustain it loses its stake. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit in a shared vault before voting or earning rewards. Sybil attackers must fund many separate deposits, and the velvet penalty of slashing makes mass fake identities economically ruinous, since the cost of maintaining them exceeds any reward they could harvest. This model fits agent once0002's threat model.
